description: TIME magazine cover dated May 29, 2017, showing a digital illustration of the White House mid-transformation into a Russian building: the west half is the familiar white neoclassical facade while the rest is red Kremlin-style brick topped with the colorful onion domes and tented spires of St. Basil's Cathedral. The image was TIME's widely circulated cover during the Trump-Russia investigation coverage. No cover headline text appears beyond the masthead and date.

Low-angle photograph of a golden statue of Lady Justice against a clear deep-blue sky. The blindfolded, crowned figure holds a raised balance scale in her left hand and an outstretched sword in her right. Commonly used stock imagery symbolizing justice and the rule of law; the original filename pattern is consistent with a HuffPost CDN image. The specific statue and its location are not identified in the image.
flags: Statue location not identifiable from the image

description: Screenshot of a 'Countable Data Brief' web-analytics summary page for the domain Threatknowledge.org, with annotations added: a red oval circles the name Katharine Gorka and blue underlines mark 'Threat Knowledge Group LLC'. The text states the site has been tracked since January 2016, ranked as high as 740,481 worldwide, and was owned by Katharine Gorka of Threat Knowledge Group LLC and hosted by GoDaddy.com LLC. The annotations present the domain-ownership record as the point of interest.
text: Countable Data Brief. Threatknowledge.org is tracked by us since January, 2016. Over the time it has been ranked as high as 740 481 in the world, while most of its traffic comes from USA, where it reached as high as 101 231 position. All this time it was owned by Katharine Gorka of Threat Knowledge Group LLC, it was hosted by GoDaddy.com LLC. Threatknowledge has the lowest Google pagerank and bad results in terms of Yandex topical citation index. We found that Threatknowledge.org is poorly 'socialized' in respect to any social network. According to Siteadvisor and Google safe browsing analytics, Threatknowledge.org is quite a safe domain with no visitor reviews.
flags: Ownership claim comes from a third-party web-analytics aggregator page, not an official registry record
